UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Private student OST review progress, Glam Stars balance, and unlocked brushes, tools, and shades.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

displayName.description: Student display name shown inside her private studio.

glamStars.description: Spendable Glam Stars earned by correctly answering Algebra 1 OST problems.

totalQuestionsSolved.description: Total number of correct OST answers recorded over time.

totalIncorrect.description: Total number of incorrect OST answers recorded over time.

streak.description: Current consecutive correct OST answer streak.

solvedIds.description: Bounded list of mastered OST problem IDs (up to 350).

unlockedShades.description: Bounded list of unlocked makeup shade IDs.

unlockedTools.description: Bounded list of unlocked brush sizes, wipe tool, makeup zones, and wing/lash styles.

topicStats.description: Map of topic index keys (t0..t9) to { correct, incorrect } counts over time.

dailyStats.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD dates (up to 90 days) to { correct, incorrect } counts over time.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress update.

SavedFigure.title: SavedFigure
SavedFigure.description: A saved model portrait look created with physical cursor brushwork.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who saved this look.

title.description: Custom look name given by the student.

modelId.description: Identifier of the selected realistic model.

thumbnailDataUrl.description: Compact JPEG preview snapshot of the painted portrait.

makeupState.description: Map of applied makeup zones to shade, finish, opacity, and style settings.

zoneMasks.description: Map of painted zone IDs to compact PNG alpha-mask data URLs for reloading strokes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the look was first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the look was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private student OST progress, Glam Stars balance, and unlocked brushes/tools/shades.

/users/{userId}/figures/{figureId}.description: Saved makeup looks owned by the student, supporting preview, reload onto canvas, and delete.
